name: noesis
description: Psychology Plugin -- an AI-powered self-understanding and self-assessment plugin for general adults in the AI era, wrapping Psychology MCP (Seges.ai's free psychometric scoring server, built under Project Noesis). Welcoming to neurodivergent people among everyone else, not ND-exclusive, and not a clinical service (refers out to real counselors via find_counselors, available to every signed-in user with a weekly/monthly usage cap, rather than providing therapy itself). Provides strength-framed interpretation of validated psychological/psychometric instruments -- population norms exist for some but not most (see each instrument's population_norms field), and none are neurodivergence-specific -- plus AI coaching.
